text: "If X then Y unless Z" is represented by which of the following formulas in propositional logic? (~ is negation, ∧ is conjunction, and → is implication)
solution: P→Q ≡ "Q unless ¬P". Reading "if X then Y unless Z" as (X→Y) unless Z gives ¬Z→(X→Y) ≡ Z∨¬X∨Y ≡ ¬(X∧¬Z)∨Y ≡ (X∧¬Z)→Y.
